Explain why the circumcenter is found at the meeting of the perpendicular bisectors.
items.answer: A point on the perpendicular bisector of a side is equidistant from that side's two endpoints (vertices); the point on all three perpendicular bisectors is equidistant from all three vertices, so it is the center of the circle through them.

steps: Perpendicular bisectors give points equidistant from vertices.
